title: AS2: string-escape unescaping corrupts a literal backslash before an escape letter
description:
packages/core/src/as2/parser.ts:1037-1046 uses chained sequential .replace() running 
->newline, 	, , quotes BEFORE \->\ (last), so \n (backslash+n) is consumed by the 
 rule. Verified: source "a\nb" compiles the pooled string to bytes 61 5c 0a 62 (a, backslash, NEWLINE, b) instead of 61 5c 6e 62 (a, backslash, n, b). Any string with a literal backslash before n/t/r/quote/0/x/u is corrupted (Windows paths like C:
ew, regex-in-string). Also  ,  , \v escapes are entirely unsupported. Fix: single left-to-right scan honoring one escape at a time (process \ atomically), not ordered global replaces; add     \v. Confidence: confirmed.
